messages:
Asha (CS): Heads-up: multiple new-onboard tenants seeing embeddings not appearing in search and sporadic 5xx on create between 07:04-07:18 UTC. Need a short customer-safe status and an offer for credits + enablement.
Ben (Eng): Quick triage: a misrouted schema flag in the batcher caused some UIDs to be written with legacy header -> validator dropped them downstream. We've paused the faulty batcher and started targeted replays. No signs of data exfiltration.
Gina (SRE): Mitigation steps: pause batcher v3, kick replay jobs for affected tenant list, and warm new reader pool. Expected catch-up window 1.5-2h. Monitoring dash: https://internal.metrics/embeds/460123
Marco (AM): I'll prepare tailored outreach for trials/renewals. Proposed one-liner: "We're mitigating an ingestion issue impacting a small set of accounts; engineering is replaying affected data and we expect full recovery soon. We're offering account credits and live troubleshooting sessions." Thoughts?
Asha (CS): LGTM. Offer: $150 credit or 10% of monthly bill (whichever is greater) + 30-min enablement. Ask customers to share failing job IDs or a sample payload.
Ben (Eng): Add a quick customer check after we confirm recovery: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -d '{"input":"hello"}' -w '
HTTP:%{http_code}
'``` expect HTTP:200 and payload contains "embedding_size".
IncidentBot: Replay jobs started for tenants: t-102, t-205, t-311. Replay progress=0% -> 7%
Asha (CS): Action items: 1) Marco send comms to impacted list 2) CS collect payloads in tracker https://docs.internal/cs/incident-460123-feedback 3) SRE confirm when replay done and post final reconfirm. I'll collate replies and escalate any renewal-risk accounts.
Marco (AM): Sending now, will paste replies here.
Gina (SRE): Replay currently 23% progress. No new errors.
Asha (CS): Thanks team. We'll publish an initial status email and follow-up RCA within 48h.
